name: month_offset
description: Name the month after a forward calendar offset, with matched control naming the offset in cardinal words.
generator_code:
import json,random
random.seed(0)
months='January February March April May June July August September October November December'.split()
nums='one two three four five six'.split();items=[];control=[]
for i in range(120):
 m=i%12;k=random.randint(1,6)
 prefix=f'Start in {months[m]} and move forward {k} months. '
 items.append({'prompt':prefix+'What month do you reach? Answer:', 'answer':' '+months[(m+k)%12]})
 control.append({'prompt':prefix+'How many months did you move? Answer in one English word:', 'answer':' '+nums[k-1]})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
